title: agentic-os
summary: Self-hosted agent orchestration where the model provider is swappable independently of the plumbing.
problem: Agent tooling tends to bind orchestration to whichever model provider you started with, so switching means rewriting the plumbing.
approach: Separate orchestration from inference: a gateway and router own the conversation, specialist agents do the work, and the provider sits behind an interface that can be swapped.
highlights: Messaging gateway and router dispatching to specialist agents.
Approval workflows for actions that need a human.
Inference provider swappable independently of the orchestration.
Used daily, which is the only reason it's any good.
